frozen_selection_integrity.interpretation_of_hash_change: TESSCut regenerated archive containers did not reproduce the parent byte-level ZIP/FITS hashes, but every admitted trial was required to match the frozen source FITS name plus A/B/C TIME, CADENCENO and QUALITY=0 within the preregistered tolerance before FLUX was analyzed. No B cadence was reselected.

admitted_claim: In the independently prepointed TESS cadence-native aperture test, none of the 42 frozen B cadences passed the preregistered isolated-B candidate gate. Forty trials were sensitivity-qualified as no isolated-B events by recovering both +10sigma and +12sigma synthetic central-cadence injections. Two trials remain unresolved because +10sigma was not recovered even though +12sigma was recovered; both raw B measurements were negative, not positive, excursions relative to their local isolated-contrast controls. These two are not counted as null trials.
not_admitted: Treating negative raw excursions in the two unresolved trials as sensitivity-qualified absence.
